changes: Added optional Trusted Device / Quick Login after a normal password sign-in, without extending the 30-minute application session.
Quick Login can restore a session automatically or require a 4-digit PIN, with a password sign-in fallback always available.
Accounts now allow one active trusted device at a time; replacing or removing a device securely revokes its old credential.
Added trusted-device status and PIN controls in Settings, plus administrator revocation controls in User Accounts.
Password resets, account deactivation, and device revocation now prevent affected devices from using Quick Login.
